journal_lines: Phantom diving from above. Watched for the shadow.
Screech overhead. Looked up in time.
They come in pairs at this depth.
Watched the sky before moving between cover.
The wingbeat sound before the shadow. Better warning system.
Three at once. Fast and overlapping.
It got a claw into the shoulder. Kept going.
The membrane tears. Collected what was left.
After the fourth night without rest, these start to arrive. Rested before continuing.
One screeched at me from a distance. The others came.
Watched its dive pattern. Hit it at the bottom.
It caught the bag straps. Pulled them back.
Held still. They lost the target. Found it again anyway.
Two diving in sequence. Handled the first. Handled the second.
Kept moving under cover until I had to cross open ground.
